name: Agent Inbox
description: What your agents and scripts wait on you for, in one sidebar panel: workspaces they parked on the board with the reason, and the messages they sent. They call one CLI at the points of your workflow that need you.

cover.alt: The Agent Inbox panel: three asks waiting on you grouped by project, unread messages, and the wired points of a workflow.

settings.title: Log file
settings.description: Where the agent-inbox CLI writes messages and the panel reads them. ~ is your home folder. The CLI follows a change once the panel has opened since; a new path starts a new log and a new list of wired points, and leaves the old files where they are. Setup: agents and scripts call ~/.config/agent-inbox/bin/agent-inbox. To wire your workflow, give your agent this prompt: Read ~/.config/agent-inbox/agent-guide.md, go through my workflow, and tell me where to send Agent Inbox messages and how to wire each one. Later, to wire a new workflow, give the same prompt with that workflow's name in place of "my workflow": the agent keeps what is already wired and covers only the new one.

settings.title: Keep messages for (days)
settings.description: Older lines are deleted from the log when Orca starts, every hour and when settings change. Messages and asks are kept at most 30 days: older lines go, including the reason of a request still waiting on you.

settings.title: Keep asks until marked handled
settings.description: On: an ask stays under Waiting on you until you press Mark handled: going to the agent, the agent running agent-inbox resolve and its card leaving the waiting column no longer take it away. One the agent resolved says Agent resumed. Asks resolved before you turn this on do not come back. Off: an ask goes when the agent resolves it or its card leaves the waiting column.

settings.title: Keep messages unread until marked read
settings.description: On: opening a message's link leaves it unread until you press Mark read or Mark all read. Off: opening its link marks it read.

settings.title: Mark messages read after (minutes)
settings.description: Point ids and minutes after which their messages count as read. One entry per line or comma separated, for example: nightly-e2e: 5, qa-report: 30, deploy-watch: 120. A point not listed never becomes read on its own.

settings.title: Show recommended points
settings.description: On: the panel shows Recommended points after Wired points: points Agent Inbox wires itself, added with one press. Off: the section goes; a recommended point you added keeps working and stays under Wired points, where Remove stops it.

settings.title: Show point search
settings.description: On: a search box above Messages filters messages by point, and one above Wired points filters the points. Off: both boxes go, and every message and point shows.

settings.title: orca command
settings.description: Path to the orca CLI (orca.exe on Windows). Leave empty to find it in the Orca app or on PATH.
